text:
Tara Nguyen: Heads up — we're prepping a migration of our old onboarding email sequences into the new Playbook Automation engine. Need input on safe mapping and an owner fallback for any orphaned sequences.
Alex M: Nice. Are these the legacy sequences with multiple branching steps? any examples?
Tara Nguyen: Yes, the ones created in 2019. Example: sequence_id=seq-2019-42 that fires when `health_score < 60` + `last_touch > 14d`.
Ben (CS Ops): Two quick asks: 1) we should not move any sequence that writes to deprecated fields. 2) need an owner_claim fallback so an unassigned account goes to a queue rather than 00000-user.
Tara Nguyen: Agreed. Proposed fallback: unassigned -> "onboard-ops-claim-queue" and send a 1hr SLA ping.
Lina - PM: For mapping rules, can we also translate health-score buckets to playbook triggers? i.e., low/medium/high -> low: "nudge-1", med: "engage-2", high: skip.
Alex M: That mapping looks fine. Also want to capture enablement feedback when a sequence sends a demo invite. Can we add a webhook to /cs-feedback so we capture accept/decline events?
Ben (CS Ops): Yes — prefer webhook + event label on contact record. Suggest payload: 
```
{
  "event": "sequence_action",
  "sequence_id": "seq-2019-42",
  "action": "accepted|declined",
  "contact_id": "...",
  "source": "playbook"
}
```
Tara Nguyen: Perfect. One more: we need a dry-run toggle and a migration report that lists: sequence_id, affected_contacts_count, owner_after_migration, deprecated_field_hits.
onboard-bot: Migration checklist created: migrate-sequences-1789998888. Dry-run flag: ON. Assigned reviewer: Ben (CS Ops). :white_check_mark:
Ben (CS Ops): I'll run a small sample (100 accounts) tomorrow, will post results here. If we see >5% deprecated_field_hits, we pause.
Lina - PM: Add a manual override workflow in the console so CS reps can opt-out per account before migration.
Alex M: I'll draft the transform script and add logging for field-level diffs. Sharing PR shortly.
Tara Nguyen: Thanks all — goal: start dry-run Wednesday. Will compile migration report template and share by EOD today. :pray:
